provenance.canonicalisation: RFC 8785 JCS via scripts/jcs.py; set hash is SHA-256 over JCS(vectors).
provenance.signatures: Ed25519 over domain || lowercase SHA-256 hex using fixed public test seeds; dependency-free RFC 8032 verifier.
provenance.status: candidate — no Demos runtime guarantee and no second-implementation cross-run yet
provenance.syntheticProofProfile: demos-bft-proof/test-1 fixtures define outputHash as SHA-256(JCS(storageOutput)), SHA-256(JCS(native transfer payload)), or SHA-256(JCS({accepted:true,operationId})); effectsRoot is SHA-256(JCS({pre,post})). These are test-only formulas, not production Demos wire claims.

coverage.note: ruleRefs provide rule-ID coverage; absence from a polarity set is an explicit conformance gap, not implicit coverage.

vectors.name: aw-capability-authenticated
vectors.reason: Authenticated exact capability permits two business Works plus an audit tail.

vectors.name: aw-capability-mismatch-pre-sign-fallback
vectors.reason: Before signing, a missing/mismatched capability selects the existing lifecycle.

vectors.name: aw-capability-mismatch-no-fallback
vectors.reason: Atomic execution cannot begin under a mismatched capability.

vectors.name: aw-capability-wrong-authority
vectors.reason: A buyer-resigned attestation cannot substitute for the capability's authenticated network authority.

vectors.name: aw-capability-work-version-missing
vectors.reason: Capability admission requires Work v1 in the authenticated workVersions set.

vectors.name: aw-capability-authorization-algorithm-missing
vectors.reason: Capability admission requires the authorization algorithm actually used.

vectors.name: aw-capability-proof-profile-mismatch
vectors.reason: The authenticated capability proof profile must equal the selected profile.

vectors.name: aw-capability-proof-byte-limit-missing
vectors.reason: Authenticated Atomic capability limits include a positive maxProofBytes bound.

vectors.name: aw-no-silent-fallback-after-sign
vectors.reason: A signed Atomic Work cannot silently fall back to a payment path.

vectors.name: aw-not-exactly-two-lifecycle-transactions
vectors.reason: The audit finalisation tail prevents an exactly-two lifecycle transaction claim.

vectors.name: aw-canonical-intent-and-id
vectors.reason: Pure JSON is JCS-canonicalized and its identifier is derived.

vectors.name: aw-runtime-object-marker-rejected
vectors.reason: A runtime/SDK object marker is not portable signed data.

vectors.name: aw-safe-integer-max-accepted
vectors.reason: The inclusive RFC 8785 safe-integer maximum remains valid pure JSON.

vectors.name: aw-safe-integer-bound
vectors.reason: Unsafe JSON integers fail before canonicalization.

vectors.name: aw-role-roster-order
vectors.reason: Role roster ordering is part of the deterministic wire contract.

vectors.name: aw-role-roster-duplicate
vectors.reason: A role cannot occur twice.

vectors.name: aw-required-role-order-and-unique
vectors.reason: Operation role requirements are canonical and unique.

vectors.name: aw-object-member-order-stable
vectors.reason: Object member insertion order does not affect JCS or workId; operation array order remains fixed.

vectors.name: aw-unknown-member-affects-id
vectors.reason: Unknown preserved unsigned members remain inside canonical Work bytes.

vectors.name: aw-transport-fields-outside-work-id
vectors.reason: Transport metadata outside the intent does not enter canonicalWorkBytes.

vectors.name: aw-claimed-id-mismatch
vectors.reason: Caller-supplied IDs are recomputed and mismatches rejected.

vectors.name: aw-different-id-identical-bytes
vectors.reason: Identical canonical bytes cannot be admitted under a second identity.

vectors.name: aw-execution-profile-bound
vectors.reason: An unsupported execution-profile interpretation is rejected before execution.

vectors.name: aw-valid-operation-graph
vectors.reason: The signed array is a deterministic earlier-dependency execution graph.

vectors.name: aw-operation-id-max-length
vectors.reason: A 64-character operation ID is the last valid grammar length.

vectors.name: aw-operation-id-over-max-length
vectors.reason: A 65-character operation ID crosses the fixed grammar boundary.

vectors.name: aw-operation-id-grammar
vectors.reason: Operation IDs follow the fixed grammar.

vectors.name: aw-future-dependency-rejected
vectors.reason: Future/self/unknown dependencies are rejected before execution.

vectors.name: aw-critical-only
vectors.reason: All v1 effects participate in one critical business overlay.

vectors.name: aw-closed-operation-kind
vectors.reason: An HTTP-like external operation cannot enter the closed rollback-covered set.

vectors.name: aw-preflight-not-node-proof
vectors.reason: A client simulation cannot substitute for authenticated node capability.

vectors.name: aw-expiry-last-valid-millisecond
vectors.reason: Consensus may begin execution at the final millisecond strictly before expiresAt.

vectors.name: aw-expiry-equality-rejected-before-op
vectors.reason: At expiresAt equality the Work is expired and no operation executes.

vectors.name: aw-payload-schema-exact-profile
vectors.reason: The authenticated execution profile advertises and applies one exact v1 schema for every admitted operation kind.

vectors.name: aw-payload-schema-kind-missing
vectors.reason: A capability missing the native-transfer payload schema cannot admit the Purchase Work.

vectors.name: aw-payload-schema-version-unsupported
vectors.reason: An authenticated but unsupported payload-schema version fails before authorization or execution.

vectors.name: aw-payload-schema-no-caller-inference
vectors.reason: A missing signed transfer amount cannot be inferred from caller or SDK state.
